summary: Boise County cabin on Observation Peak, 1930s, abandoned and listed gone; sources disagree on the national forest, and none of the cited sources describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Idaho list; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts call the cabin abandoned

visit.trail_note: 6.5 miles from Grandjean Trailhead, 13 miles round trip; the trail enters wilderness and a free permit is needed

evidence.supports: firelookout.com lists the Sawtooth National Forest

evidence.quote: Hike 6.5 miles up from Grandjean Trailhead up to Observation Peak

evidence.supports: free wilderness permit picked up on the trail
evidence.quote: You need a free wilderness permit which can be picked up on the trail.

evidence.supports: Boise National Forest is named as a distant view

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives the Sawtooth National Forest; Rex's Fire Lookout Page, crediting Kresek, gives the Boise National Forest, which the brief also carries. Discover Sawtooth lists the Boise National Forest among distant views, which hints the peak is not on it, but no source settles it. Left out of facts.

notes_for_editor: Agency is unresolved: the brief's Boise National Forest rests on the Kresek-credited Rex's page, and firelookout.com says Sawtooth. Editor should decide before publishing; facts.agency was left out rather than picking one. No source gives a year for the cabin, only the 1930s. The story keeps that decade, but no 'built' event is recorded because an event needs a year; an earlier 1930 event was a guess and has been removed. No source gives a year of abandonment or removal. Access level was removed: no source states one. The 'Sawtooth Wilderness' name does not appear on the trail page; that page says only that the trail enters wilderness and a free permit is needed, and the visit trail_note keeps that. Staffing is omitted because no source gives a history. The 'ground' kind in the brief matches the Idaho list's Ground label.
